name: io.github.freepik-company/jev-mcp
title: Jev MCP
description: Typed decisions with Jev / System One via OpenRouter or TypeSafe: classify, verify, rerank, decide.

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenRouter API key. Required when JEV_PROVIDER is openrouter (the default).

environmentVariables.name: TYPESAFE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: TypeSafe API key. Required when JEV_PROVIDER is typesafe.

environmentVariables.name: JEV_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Default System One model ID; each tool call may override it.
